title: Setting Up a Better Infection: Overexpression of the Early Bacteriophage T4 Gene motB During Infection Results in a More Favorable tRNA Pool for the Phage.
authors: Son, Bokyung; Patterson-West, Jennifer; Thompson, Christine O; Iben, James R; Hinton, Deborah M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究噬菌体T4早期基因motB编码的DNA结合蛋白通过改变宿主tRNA池来优化噬菌体感染，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、仅用AlphaFold预测结构，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: : Although many bacteriophage T4 early genes are nonessential with unknown functions, they are believed to aid in the takeover of the Escherichia coli host. Understanding the functions of these genes could be helpful to develop novel antibacterial strategies. MotB, encoded by a previously uncharacterized T4 early gene, is a DNA-binding protein that compacts the host nucleoid and alters host gene expression. METHODS: : MotB structure was predicted by AlphaFold 2. RNA-seq and mass spectrometry (MS) analyses were performed to determine RNA and protein changes when motB was overexpressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) +/-5 min T4 infection. RESULTS: : MotB structure is predicted to be a two-domain protein with N-terminal Kyprides-Onzonis-Woese and C-terminal oligonucleotide/oligosaccharide-fold domains. In E. coli B, motB overexpression during infection does not affect T4 RNAs, but affects the expression of host genes, including the downregulation of 21 of the 84 chargeable host tRNAs. Many of these tRNAs are used less frequently by T4 or have a counterpart encoded within the T4 genome. The MS analyses indicate that the levels of multiple T4 proteins are changed by motB overexpression. CONCLUSION: : Our results suggest that in this E. coli B host, motB is involved in establishing a more favorable tRNA pool for the phage during infection.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管许多噬菌体T4早期基因是非必需的且功能未知，但据信它们有助于接管大肠杆菌宿主。理解这些基因的功能可能有助于开发新型抗菌策略。MotB由先前未表征的T4早期基因编码，是一种DNA结合蛋白，可压缩宿主核仁并改变宿主基因表达。方法：通过AlphaFold 2预测MotB结构。进行RNA-seq和质谱（MS）分析，以确定在E. coli BL21(DE3)中过表达motB（±5分钟T4感染）时RNA和蛋白质的变化。结果：预测MotB结构为双结构域蛋白，具有N端Kyprides-Onzonis-Woese结构域和C端寡核苷酸/寡糖折叠结构域。在E. coli B中，感染期间motB过表达不影响T4 RNA，但影响宿主基因表达，包括84个可充电宿主tRNA中21个的下调。这些tRNA中有许多被T4使用频率较低，或在T4基因组内编码有对应物。MS分析表明，motB过表达改变了多种T4蛋白的水平。结论：我们的结果表明，在此E. coli B宿主中，motB参与在感染期间为噬菌体建立更有利的tRNA库。
